name: SQL Formatter for kiros33
summary: SQL formatter following the ansi-sql-format skill — tab-aligned AS/operators · WHERE 1=1 · dash lines around set operators (WASM · formatter extension)
description: A SQL formatter extension (ABI v1.1 nx_ext_format). It reuses the app's Basic formatter core (nsql-format: lexer · layout · common options) and adds the kiros33 skill rules on top: vertical tab alignment of AS / comparison operators / ORDER BY direction (longest item → next tab stop · outliers get one tab), AND/OR at the WHERE column, dash comment lines around UNION / UNION ALL / INTERSECT / MINUS, WHERE 1=1 seed. Common options (indent, comma position and gap, keyword case, one-line/multi-line lists, AND/OR position …) come from Preferences ▸ Editor ▸ SQL Formatting; sqlfmt.strict (default on) forces the skill values (tab · width 4 · leading comma · ",\t" · 1=1 · UPPER · AND at line start). Extension-only rules live under Preferences ▸ Extensions ▸ SQL Formatter for kiros33. Use it once from the palette (Format With…), set it as the default formatter (Shift+Alt+F), or open Format Preview. Out of scope in v1 (kept as written): automatic table aliases, table comments, PL/SQL block layout, dialect translation.
author: SosomLab
